gen-gf-gabarito-gf-pridi: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Pridi, a serif, leaves the showmanship to it and does refined text work, its small letters standing almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-scope-one: Scope One, a text serif, lets its counters spill outward while stubby ascenders and descenders crouch by a big x-height. And paragraphs in it feel traditional and refined, while Gabarito's compass-pencil consistency keeps the heading distinctive.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish Slabo 13px brings open counters to its tall a, e and s, while Gabarito's headings look drawn with a round-tipped pen. Expressive, drawn display up top, dignified serif text below.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-suwannaphum: Gabarito's cut-open terminals let its counters flow outward, giving the heading a hum of constant line weight. Suwannaphum, a text serif, then adds a paperclip-open c and woodblock-high lowercase.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-amulya: Contemporary and generous in its curve gaps, this sans sits against Gaegu's marker-like handwritten line, every stroke cut to a single width. Amulya is happiest with a quick glance rather than pages of text.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous room between the curve ends and the stem, against Gaegu's marker-like handwriting. Bump the body size a little; it's pleasant for a quick look.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-literata: Gaegu keeps one marker-like line width, its strokes like twine pressed flat, with chisel-notch openings. And Literata, a text serif, shifts its stroke weight noticeably but never dramatically, a sophisticated, bookish voice for brief stretches.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-neco: Neco swells in a measured way from hairline to stem, its curves thinning modestly where they turn and never pinching shut. Gaegu's handwriting is plotter-smooth, while Neco's dignity suits brief text best.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-recia: Gaegu holds a marker-like line through every turn, handwritten and inviting, with generous openings like a chisel notch in wood. Recia keeps real weight in its thinnest curves, sharpest in brief text.
gen-gf-gaegu-fs-spline-sans: Wide gaps between curve ends and stems make this body feel approachable and contemporary, set against Gaegu's handwritten, inviting marker line. Spline Sans can go a touch larger, though pages of it would tire.
